io.name: clk
io.description: Fast-running clock. All state updates occur on the rising edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset. Resets the clock to 12:00 AM. Has priority over ena and applies even when ena is low.

io.name: ena
io.description: Enable pulse; when high, the clock advances by one second on the rising edge.

io.name: hh
io.description: Two BCD digits for hours, range 01-12.

io.name: mm
io.description: Two BCD digits for minutes, range 00-59.

io.name: ss
io.description: Two BCD digits for seconds, range 00-59.

functional_summary.overview: 12-hour clock with AM/PM indicator. On each rising clk edge: if reset is high, outputs become 12:00 AM (hh=0x12, mm=0x00, ss=0x00, pm=0). Otherwise, if ena is high, the time advances by one second with BCD rollover: seconds 00-59, minutes 00-59, hours 01-12, and AM/PM toggling when hours wrap from 12 to 01 (or 11 to 12).
rules: Reset is synchronous, active-high, and has priority over ena; on reset, hh=0x12, mm=0x00, ss=0x00, pm=0.
When ena=1 and reset=0, increment seconds by one BCD count.
Seconds roll over from 59 to 00, incrementing minutes.
Minutes roll over from 59 to 00, incrementing hours.
Hours count 01,02,...,12 then wrap to 01; the wrap from 12 to 01 toggles pm.
When hours transition from 11 to 12, pm toggles (AM<->PM).
When hours transition from 12 to 01, pm toggles (AM<->PM).
All outputs update on the rising clk edge with one-cycle latency relative to sampled inputs.
Outputs are held when ena=0 and reset=0.
